sources.snippet: GLM-4.7-Flash is Z.ai's new 30B MoE reasoning model built for local deployment, delivering best-in-class performance for coding, agentic workflows, and chat. It uses ~3.6B parameters, supports 200K context, and leads SWE-Bench, GPQA, and reasoning/chat benchmarks. sources.snippet: What is GLM-4.7-Flash Heretic? GLM-4.7-Flash Heretic is an abliterated (uncensored) variant of Zhipu AI's GLM-4.7-Flash model.
